page_title: SEV 0-3 GET | Sevilla v Getafe 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Jaime Mata (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Juan Pulido and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
90+3' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
90+3' The referee signals a substitution. Omar Alderete (Getafe) is brought on as a substitute for Juanmi Latasa.
90+1' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the David Soria anticipates well and smothers the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) replaces Mason Greenwood.
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) for Luis Milla.
89' Close! Rafa Mir (Sevilla) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
87' Getafe fail to score from a corner as Marko Dmitrovic (Sevilla) leaps to collect the ball.
86' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Pulido had an easy-decision to make.
80' 0 - 3 Goal! Mason Greenwood (Getafe) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marko Dmitrovic into the bottom left corner.
80' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
80' Handball! A player from Sevilla handled the ball. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Getafe.
77' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
75' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

73' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) wins himself some space to meet the corner kick and unleashes a low shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
73' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) steps up to send the ball in.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rafa Mir (Sevilla) will replace Djibril Sow.

71' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
69' The attendance is 30005.
68' Borja Mayoral does a good job setting up Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) on the edge of the box, but his nice effort curls just over the bar.
67' It looks like Djibril Sow (Sevilla) saw red with that tackle. Juan Pulido won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
65' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) will deliver the corner kick.
65' Substitution. Suso (Sevilla) in, Lucas Ocampos out.
59' A precise low pass is received by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.

58' What an opportunity! Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post!
56' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) sends a cross in and finds Adnan Januzaj inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
55' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
53' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) forces a pass into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.

51' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Sevilla are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
47' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
46' Diego Alonso has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) comes on the pitch for Kike Salas.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Pulido starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
45+3' 63:37 – the latest ball possession ratio.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

42' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom right corner, but Marko Dmitrovic is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
40' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
37' 0 - 2 Mason Greenwood provides Jaime Mata (Getafe) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
35' Golden chance! Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
34' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
34' Jose Bordalas Jimenez isn't happy on the touchline after referee Juan Pulido shows him a yellow card.
30' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.
30' Wonderful movement by Getafe. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
28' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
24' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
24' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
23' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Pulido who sees an offensive foul.
22' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
22' A pass into the penalty area from Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is intercepted by the defence. Sevilla win a corner.
21' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is behind the touchline and Getafe will take a throw-in.
18' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
17' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) swings it in and Ivan Rakitic gets on the end of it, but David Soria shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
16' David Soria (Getafe) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
14' David Soria (Getafe) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
12' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Luis Milla (Getafe) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
10' The foul by Djibril Sow (Sevilla) was seen by Juan Pulido who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Borja Mayoral (Getafe) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Marko Dmitrovic.
5' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is going to take the penalty!
4' Marko Dmitrovic (Sevilla) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
4' Handball by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla). Penalty awarded! Getafe will take a penalty kick.
3' Jaime Mata (Getafe) has an effort from close range after latching on to a precise pass, but he can't beat one of the defenders who makes a good block.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Sevilla will have the kick-off.
